defects.description: A false Debug in the override is treated as unset, so a layer can enable debug but no higher layer can ever disable it.

trigger.input: Load(Config{Debug: true, Retries: 5}, Config{Debug: false, Retries: 0}).Debug

defects.why_missed: Every suite override sets non-zero values, so the guard that mistakes a zero value for absence is never distinguished from a genuinely unset field.

defects.description: Retries set to 0 by the override is treated as unset, so retries cannot be turned off from a higher layer.

trigger.input: Load(Config{Debug: true, Retries: 5}, Config{Debug: false, Retries: 0}).Retries

defects.why_missed: The suite overrides retries to 5; zero is the one value the merge cannot express, and no test asks for it.
